john.18.p1.b1.text: After Jesus had spoken these words, He went out with His disciples across the Kidron Valley, where they entered a garden.

john.18.p1.b2.text: Now Judas His betrayer also knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with His disciples.

john.18.p1.b3.text: So Judas brought a band of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees. They arrived at the garden carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.

john.18.p2.b4.text: When Jesus said, “I am He,” they drew back and fell to the ground.

john.18.p3.b2.text: I told you that I am He … So if you are looking for Me, let these men go.

john.18.p3.b3.text: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: “I have not lost one of those You have given Me.”

john.18.p4.b1.text: Then Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

john.18.p4.b2.text: Put your sword back in its sheath!

john.18.p4.b3.text: Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me?

john.18.p5.b1.text: Then the band of soldiers, with its commander and the officers of the Jews, arrested Jesus and bound Him.

john.18.p5.b2.text: They brought Him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.

john.18.p5.b3.text: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it would be better if one man died for the people.

john.18.p6.b1.text: Now Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. … he also went with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest.

john.18.p6.b2.text: … went out and spoke to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.

john.18.p6.b3.text: Aren’t you also one of this man’s disciples?

john.18.p7.b1.text: Because it was cold, the servants and officers were standing around a charcoal fire they had made to keep warm.

john.18.p7.b2.text: And Peter was also standing with them, warming himself.

john.18.p8.b1.text: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and His teaching.

john.18.p8.b2.text: I have spoken openly to the world … I said nothing in secret.

john.18.p8.b3.text: Why are you asking Me? Ask those who heard My message.

john.18.p9.b1.text: Is this how You answer the high priest?

john.18.p9.b2.text: If I said something wrong, testify as to what was wrong. But if I spoke correctly, why did you strike Me?

john.18.p9.b3.text: Then Annas sent Him, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.

john.18.p10.b1.text: Aren’t you also one of His disciples?

john.18.p10.b3.text: Didn’t I see you with Him in the garden?

john.18.p10.b4.text: Peter denied it once more, and immediately a rooster crowed.

john.18.p11.b1.text: Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. By now it was early morning …

john.18.p11.b2.text: … the Jews did not enter the Praetorium, to avoid being defiled and unable to eat the Passover.

john.18.p11.b3.text: What accusation are you bringing against this man?

john.18.p11.b4.text: If He were not a criminal … we would not have handed Him over to you.

john.18.p12.b1.text: You take Him and judge Him by your own law …

john.18.p12.b2.text: We are not permitted to execute anyone,

john.18.p12.b3.text: Are You the King of the Jews?

john.18.p12.b4.text: Are you saying this on your own … or did others tell you about Me?

john.18.p13.b1.text: My kingdom is not of this world; … But now My kingdom is not of this realm.

john.18.p13.b3.text: You say that I am a king … For this reason I was born and have come into the world, to testify to the truth.

john.18.p13.b4.text: Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to My voice.

john.18.p14.b2.text: And having said this, he went out again to the Jews …

john.18.p14.b3.text: I find no basis for a charge against Him.

john.18.p15.b1.text: But it is your custom that I release to you one prisoner at the Passover. So then, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
